description: Statii reincarcare finantate prin PNRR is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerul Dezvoltării Regionale și Administrației Publice. Electric vehicle recharging stations grouped by ATUs and counties, financed by NRRPs, C5 and C10. Coverage: Ministerul Dezvoltării Regionale și Administrației Publice. The portal shows the English title as "Electric vehicle recharging stations funded by the NRRP" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerul Dezvoltării Regionale și Administrației Publice. Its keywords include MDLPA, UAT-uri, lista, judete, PNRR, statii reincarcare vehicule electrice. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
